name: Do I need to own land before contacting a custom home builder?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to own land before contacting a custom home builder?

acceptedAnswer.text: While owning land is not strictly necessary before contacting a custom home builder, it is highly recommended to have a clear idea of your desired location and whether you plan to purchase land or already own it. A builder can help evaluate potential sites for suitability, identify any unique challenges, and estimate site development costs, which are crucial for budgeting. If you don't own land yet, a builder might be able to offer guidance on finding a suitable lot that aligns with your custom home vision.
acceptedAnswer.description: While not strictly required, it's beneficial to have a clear location in mind or own land before contacting a builder. They can help evaluate sites.
